# Wip limits

`customer_support.df.queue_management.wip_limits` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Work-in-progress limits — cap what is held open per agent and per queue, rather than targeting what is closed.

Throughput targets encourage starting; WIP limits encourage finishing. Since wait is driven by how much is simultaneously in flight, limiting the in-flight count lowers wait without anyone working faster.
